description: This is a 3D model preview of a stacked chest, possibly for storage or as part of a game asset. It appears to be constructed from dark, rough-hewn material, possibly wood or metal, with visible horizontal banding or reinforcement. The chest has a rectangular shape and is stacked vertically, suggesting it could be part of a larger structure or a single, multi-layered container. The texture is somewhat weathered, giving it a rustic or industrial feel. The overall impression is one of utility and perhaps a sense of age or durability.
